🧭

Clear roadmaps

Living documents

⚡

Instant boards

🔔

🔒

Single sign-on, granular roles, audit logs, and encryption at rest and in transit come standard, not as an expensive afterthought.

📊

Honest reporting

Burndown, cycle time, and workload charts built from real activity, not manual updates. Share a live report link in seconds.

🌍

Made for remote

Connects to your stack

Over 120 integrations with code hosts, chat apps, design tools, calendars, and support desks. Or build your own with our open API.

How it works

From first idea to shipped in four steps

Getting started takes an afternoon, not a quarter. Here is the path most teams follow in their first week.

Import your work

Bring in projects from spreadsheets or other tools with one click. We map fields, owners, and dates for you.

Shape your workflow

Choose a template or sketch your own stages. Add rules so routine handoffs happen automatically.

Invite your team

Add teammates, clients, and contractors with the right level of access. Everyone sees only what they need.

Ship with confidence

Track progress through live reports and a daily digest. Spot risks early and celebrate wins together.

Planning

Lumen Flow rolls up work from every team into a single view that adapts to your audience. Executives get outcomes, managers get capacity, and makers get a clear list for today.

Integrations

Plays nicely with the tools you already love

Connect your code, chat, design, and support tools in minutes. Updates flow both ways so nobody retypes anything.

Code & deploys

Chat & email

Turn any message into a task, get digests in your inbox, and reply to comments straight from your favorite messaging app.

Design & docs

Embed prototypes, whiteboards, and spreadsheets so reviewers never leave the conversation to find the latest version.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Can't find what you need? Our team replies within one business day.

How long does it take to get started?

Most teams are up and running in an afternoon. Import your existing projects, pick a template, and invite your teammates. Our guided setup walks you through each step and our support team is happy to help.

Can I import data from my current tool?

Yes. We support one click imports from popular project tools and CSV files. Fields, assignees, comments, and attachments are mapped automatically, and you can preview the result before anything is saved.

Is there a free plan?

The Starter plan is free forever for up to five collaborators. Paid plans include a 14 day trial with every feature unlocked, no credit card required.

How do you handle security and privacy?

Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We offer single sign-on, role based permissions, and detailed audit logs. We never sell data, and you can export or delete everything whenever you like.

Can clients and contractors join my workspace?

Absolutely. Guest roles let outside collaborators see only the projects you share with them. Internal notes and private fields stay hidden, and access can be revoked instantly.

What if I need to cancel?

Cancel from your billing page at any time. You keep access until the end of the paid period, and you can download a full export of your workspace before you go.

Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?

Yes. Verified nonprofits, schools, and open source maintainers receive up to 50% off paid plans. Contact our team with a short description of your organization.

Ready when you are

Give your team room to do their best work

Join thousands of teams who traded notification overload for clarity. Your first project can be live in minutes.
